paragraphs.source_en: Lately, Ōkubo Nagayasu had been dreaming constantly, even when he passed out drunk. Frequent dreams were often caused by a weakening of the vital organs. Some revived things he had done in his youth; others drew him into hazy realms of illusion. All were inexplicable.

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, even if Date's rumor-mongering came to light, he would surely feign ignorance and insist that he knew nothing about it. But how would you ever clear yourself of suspicion?” O-Kō quietly slipped both hands inside Nagayasu's collar and gently kneaded him.

paragraphs.source_en: How disheartening! Nagayasu held O-Kō tightly and, while listening to her murmured whispers, thought to himself: My expectations were too high, and so my disappointment grew deeper; that was why I drank more and more and sought amusement ever more often.

paragraphs.source_en: Yet if the retired shogun were to pass away, would the second shogun be able, as his predecessor hoped, to restrain the arrogance of the Portuguese and the Dutch and continue trading overseas?

paragraphs.source_en: As Nagayasu considered this, the Masamune in his mind smiled theatrically. “Ha-ha, so you have understood my intentions? paragraphs.source_en: While Nagayasu's thoughts ran wild, O-Kō suddenly bit hard into his shoulder.

paragraphs.source_en: Make his son-in-law shogun, have an outstanding and capable man like Ōkubo Nagayasu support him, and seize the reins of the realm... Date Masamune would surely reveal his true designs to Nagayasu.
